title: 2022 CODATA: standard atmosphere is 101 325
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks standard atmosphere as exact: 101 325 Pa.
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks standard atmosphere as exact: 101 325 Pa. No uncertainty is printed on that row. The standard atmosphere in this listing is a conventional exact pressure of 101 325 pascals. It is not a report of today's air pressure, and it is not the same number as the standard-state pressure.
